title: Map of mining claims of the Chrysolite Silver Mining Co. (1879)
label: Historic mine workings map
sourceTitle: Map of mining claims of the Chrysolite Silver Mining Co. : Fryer Hill, Leadville, Col.
sourceNote: Original 1879 company survey map of Chrysolite Silver Mining Co. on Fryer Hill, including Chrysolite claim, Roberts shaft, surrounding company claims and underground workings. Original held by University of Colorado Boulder Libraries, DPLA item 3fc6f8b58721b889df39cdb41cf0f171. Full 1536 x 1189 JPEG viewed 2026-10-14. Supplementary zoomable map, not a mine photograph.
identityEvidence: Original image visually inspected: title explicitly reads MAP OF MINING CLAIMS OF THE CHRYSOLITE SILVER MINING CO., Fryer Hill, Leadville, Colorado; the Chrysolite claim and Roberts shaft are labeled on the sheet. CU Boulder catalog confirms original survey dated Dec. 19, 1879, by George H. Robinson, reduced by James J. McGowan. Exact site/company identity verified, with other neighboring company claims shown contextually.
